privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1.title: 1. Introduction
privacy.section1.content: Welcome to Metaxas Retreats ("we," "our," or "us"). We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy. privacy.section2.item1: Names and Contact Details (Email, Phone Number)

privacy.section4.title: 4. Cookies and Tracking
privacy.section4.content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies (like Google Analytics) to access or store information. This helps us analyze website traffic and improve your user experience. You can refuse the use of cookies by adjusting your browser settings.
privacy.section5.title: 5. Data Retention

We also use Google Analytics 4 to analyze website traffic — this is only activated after you have given explicit consent via the cookie banner. Google Analytics uses cookies to collect anonymized usage data. For more information, see Google's Privacy Policy at https://policies.google.com/privacy.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How far is Metaxas Retreats from the beach?
faq.a1: Our accommodations are just 50 meters from Mikros Gialos beach, one of the most beautiful bays in Lefkada with crystal-clear turquoise waters.
faq.q2: What is the best time to visit Lefkada?
faq.a2: May to October offers the best weather for visiting Lefkada. July and August are peak season with warmest temperatures, while May–June and September–October offer pleasant weather with fewer crowds.
faq.q3: What accommodations are available at Metaxas Retreats?
faq.a3: We offer two types of accommodation: a charming Wooden House with sea views sleeping up to 4 guests, and a spacious Glamping Tent among olive trees sleeping up to 5 guests. Both feature modern amenities and stunning views of Mikros Gialos bay.
faq.q4: Is Metaxas Retreats a campground or glamping site?
faq.a4: Metaxas Retreats offers luxury glamping — combining the best of camping with hotel-quality amenities. Our glamping tent provides a unique outdoor experience with comfortable beds, air conditioning, private bathroom, and fully equipped kitchen.
faq.q5: How do I get to Metaxas Retreats from Lefkada Town?
faq.a5: From Lefkada Town, drive south along the east coast through Nidri, then follow the signs for Poros and Mikros Gialos. It's about 30 km and takes around 45 minutes. From Aktion airport (Preveza), allow about 1 hour 10 minutes.
faq.q6: What beaches are near Metaxas Retreats?
faq.a6: Mikros Gialos beach is just 50m away. Other nearby beaches include Agiofili, Porto Katsiki, and the beaches around Sivota bay.
faq.q7: How do I book at Metaxas Retreats?
faq.a7: Book directly with us for a discount: choose your dates on the accommodation page and send a request, message us on WhatsApp at +30 697 321 9980, or email metaxasretreats@gmail.com. You can also find us on Airbnb and Booking.com.

explore.schema.name: Lefkada Island, Greece
explore.schema.description: Discover Lefkada's stunning beaches, charming villages, water sports, and local cuisine.
explore.beach.mikrosGialos.name: Mikros Gialos
explore.beach.mikrosGialos.desc: A serene bay with calm turquoise waters, ideal for swimming, snorkeling, and total relaxation. Great local tavernas and your perfect base to explore the island.
explore.beach.portoKatsiki.name: Porto Katsiki
explore.beach.portoKatsiki.desc: One of the most iconic beaches in Greece, featuring dramatic white cliffs and crystal clear turquoise waters. Accessible via stairs descending the cliff.
explore.beach.egremni.name: Egremni
explore.beach.egremni.desc: A long stretch of pristine white sand and stunning blue waters. Famous for its 350 steps leading down to paradise.
explore.beach.kathisma.name: Kathisma
explore.beach.kathisma.desc: A popular organized beach with golden sand and crystal waters. Perfect for water sports and beach bars.
explore.beach.milos.name: Milos Beach
explore.beach.milos.desc: A beautiful unspoiled beach near Agios Nikitas, accessible only by boat or by hiking through a scenic trail.
explore.beach.agiofili.name: Agiofili
explore.beach.agiofili.desc: A small hidden gem with crystal clear turquoise waters, surrounded by olive trees and accessible by boat from Vasiliki.
explore.village.mikrosGialos.name: Mikros Gialos
explore.village.mikrosGialos.desc: A beautiful coastal village with a stunning turquoise bay. Peaceful beaches, charming tavernas serving fresh seafood, and a laid-back atmosphere.
explore.village.sivota.name: Sivota
explore.village.sivota.desc: An idyllic yacht harbor with emerald waters and excellent fish tavernas around the bay, just a short drive from Mikros Gialos.
explore.village.lefkadaTown.name: Lefkada Town
explore.village.lefkadaTown.desc: The charming capital with colorful buildings, a marina full of yachts, pedestrian streets, and numerous shops and restaurants.
explore.village.agiosNikitas.name: Agios Nikitas
explore.village.agiosNikitas.desc: A picturesque fishing village with traditional architecture, narrow streets, and direct access to beautiful beaches.
explore.village.nidri.name: Nidri
explore.village.nidri.desc: A lively resort town with stunning views of the neighboring islands and a vibrant waterfront promenade.
explore.village.vasiliki.name: Vasiliki
explore.village.vasiliki.desc: A windsurfing paradise in a sheltered bay, with a relaxed atmosphere and seafront tavernas.
explore.activity.boatTrips.title: Boat Trips
explore.activity.boatTrips.desc: Rent a boat from Mikros Gialos and explore the nearby islands of Meganisi, Kalamos, and Kastos. Discover secluded beaches.
explore.activity.windsurfing.title: Windsurfing & Kitesurfing
explore.activity.windsurfing.desc: Vasiliki Bay is one of Europe's top windsurfing destinations, with perfect afternoon thermal winds.
explore.activity.sailing.title: Sailing
explore.activity.sailing.desc: Rent a sailboat or join a sailing tour to explore the nearby islands of Meganisi, Kalamos, and Kastos.
explore.activity.hiking.title: Hiking
explore.activity.hiking.desc: Follow well-marked trails through olive groves and mountains. The hike to the Dimosari Waterfall is particularly beautiful.
explore.activity.beachHopping.title: Beach Hopping
explore.activity.beachHopping.desc: Take a boat tour to visit the island's most spectacular beaches, many accessible only by water.
explore.activity.diving.title: Scuba Diving
explore.activity.diving.desc: Explore underwater caves, shipwrecks, and vibrant marine life with one of the island's diving schools.
